samples.analysis:
Google Chrome is open in Incognito mode on a YOLOKFX webpage; the tab title begins “How to Get Free SHEIN Produc…”.

- A black site header shows the **YOLOKFX** logo, menu links **HOME**, **FASHION**, **TRENDS**, and **CONTACT**, plus a search icon.
- The centered article is titled **“How to Get Free SHEIN Products”**, with introductory text about the official SHEIN reviewer program.
- A prompt says **“One last question and we will show you how!”** and asks how the user prefers to receive free items. Two large green buttons are labeled **Store pickup** and **Home delivery**.
- Below is a large **SHEIN** logo and an **OFFICIAL REVIEWER PROGRAM** badge, followed by explanatory paragraphs stating that selected users may test products and that selection is **never guaranteed**.
- A bold section heading reads **“🔥 THE MOST IMPORTANT STEP BEFORE APPLYING”** and advises keeping the SHEIN profile complete and updated.
- Ads are visible above and to the right, including **“Find Leg Vein Relief” / “BOOK NOW”** and a Capital One Shopping ad reading **“Coupon codes found!”** with an **Apply Codes** button.
